description.text:
We are building an AIDC AI service platform that provides enterprise-grade AI model deployment, Token as a Service, AI Agents, inference services, RAG, model APIs, and automated AI workflows.
This role will be responsible for AI model development, model serving, agent system design, inference platform integration, and integration with the AIDC Portal, Billing system, and GPU infrastructure.
You will lead the end-to-end process from model selection, training, deployment, inference optimization, API enablement, and commercial service delivery.
Key Responsibilities
• Build and maintain AI model services, including LLMs, embedding models, rerankers, vision models, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and multi-model API services.
• Develop the Token as a Service platform, including token APIs, usage tracking, token quota, rate limiting, pricing support, billing integration, API keys, and usage dashboards.
• Design and build AI Agent systems, including workflow agents, RAG agents, tool-calling agents, customer service agents, data analysis agents, internal automation agents, and multi-agent orchestration.
• Deploy and optimize AI models for production inference, including model serving, GPU inference optimization, batch inference, streaming response, quantization, and evaluation of tools such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, Ollama, and llama.cpp.
• Build RAG and knowledge base systems, including document chunking, vector databases, embedding pipelines, retrieval strategies, prompt engineering, and evaluation pipelines.
• Integrate AI services with the AIDC platform, including GPU resource scheduling, model deployment APIs, token usage metering, portal integration, billing integration, API Gateway, and Worker-based API proxy.
• Establish AI model governance, including prompt injection protection, sensitive data handling, output moderation, model evaluation, logging, tracing, observability, cost monitoring, and performance monitoring.
Requirements
• Strong Python programming skills.
• Understanding of LLMs, Transformers, embeddings, RAG, and modern AI application architecture.
• Experience with at least one AI framework such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face.
• Experience building APIs using FastAPI, Flask, Express, or similar frameworks.
• Familiarity with Docker, Linux, and GPU environments.
• Experience with prompt engineering and model API integration.
• Experience in model deployment, inference services, or AI application development.
• Ability to turn AI models into production-ready and commercially usable API services.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with vLLM, Triton Inference Server, TensorRT-LLM, or similar inference platforms.
• Experience with Kubernetes, GPU Operator, NVIDIA CUDA, or GPU infrastructure.
• Experience with RAG and vector databases such as Milvus, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or pgvector.
• Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
• Experience with model fine-tuning such as LoRA, QLoRA, or SFT.
• Experience building production-grade AI Agent systems.
• Experience with model compression, quantization, and inference acceleration.
• Experience with billing, token metering, API monetization, or usage-based pricing.
Common Technology Stack
Languages: Python / TypeScript
AI: PyTorch / Hugging Face / vLLM / Triton / TensorRT-LLM
Agents: LangChain / LlamaIndex / CrewAI / AutoGen
RAG: Embeddings / Vector DB / Reranker / Knowledge Base
Backend: FastAPI / Flask / Node.js
Infrastructure: Docker / Linux / NVIDIA GPU / Kubernetes
Database: PostgreSQL / Redis / Vector DB
Cloudflare: Workers / Tunnel / R2 / Access
Expected Outcomes
• Build the AIDC AI Model Serving Platform.
• Deliver the Token as a Service API.
• Establish token usage tracking and billing integration.
• Build an enterprise AI Agent platform.
• Build RAG and knowledge base solutions.
• Establish model deployment, monitoring, performance optimization, and security governance workflows.
